title: The Fifteenth Amendment: the vote is not to be denied for race, color, or previous servitude
summary: Section 1 binds the United States and the states. The page is the amendment, not a history of whether the promise was kept.
body: The National Archives milestone page prints Section 1 of the Fifteenth Amendment: 'The right of citizens of the United States to vote shall not be denied or abridged by the United States or by any State on account of race, color, or previous condition of servitude.' The amendment names those grounds. It does not, in this section, mention sex. The Nineteenth Amendment is a different text.
